title: Padding a CNF to a fixed clause count
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be natural numbers, and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $r+a$ coordinates with at most $K$ clauses. If $a+3\le K$, there is a constructed CNF formula on $r+K$ coordinates with exactly $K$ clauses: positions below the number of clauses of $\psi$ use its corresponding lifted clauses, and all remaining positions use filler clauses.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a CNF formula on $r+a$ coordinates
caveat: The definitions of clause lifting and filler clauses are absent, so their precise mathematical content cannot be stated.
